about: Per-shape diagnoses Core states, as data (aegis_perf::analysis). Each names the shape, the arch, a short label, the statement, and the doc section it comes from. Edit this file (and the cited section) to add, revise or withdraw one; readers show only what is here.

diagnoses.label: below floor: launch-overhead bound
diagnoses.statement: The 896x896 shapes run at ~65-70% of the floor, and cuBLASLt at 58-66%. They are bound by launch overhead: fixed per-launch cost (launch, ramp, tail) against a ~6 µs transfer.
